Peter’s Chains fall off

Richard Crashaw (c. 1613–1649)

‘The chains spontaneously fell from Peter, and the (prison) doors opened.’—A
CTS XII.
 
7–10
.
I
RON
 forgets ’tis iron;
the chains dissemble too;
Nor has the prison, doors
for Peter now.
Free truly is that pris’ner
who by the prison’s freed,
Whom chains themselves unbind,
free is indeed.
